_about: Auditorium geometry, version 2 (18 Nov 2026). Source: the team's hand sketch with tape measurements (floorplan/source-sketches/2026-11-18-hand-sketch-tape-measurements.jpg) and the team's answers the same day. Replaces version 1, which was read off the cable-planning tool and had the width and the runway length wrong; v1 is kept as floorplan/auditorium-dimensions-v1-cable-plan.json. Each value says how it is known: 'measured' = the team's tape measurement; 'derived' = arithmetic on measured values; 'not measured' = drawn where the sketch shows it, or carried over from v1, only so the plan can be drawn. Do not build to a 'not measured' value. 19 Nov 2026: room length, the console's position, heights and wall finishes added as estimates from the team's photos (see photo_estimates and docs/13-auditorium-from-photos.md); they are labelled 'estimated from photos'.

coordinate_system.origin: Corner of the stage end wall and the top wall, with the plan drawn stage-left as in the cable-planning tool
coordinate_system.x: Along the length, from the stage end wall toward the back wall behind the sound console
coordinate_system.z: Across the width, from the top wall (the 11.65 m side, team 18 Nov) to the bottom wall (the LF platform side)
coordinate_system.y: Up. Ceiling height not measured (photos suggest about 7.5-8.5 m).

auditorium.length_confidence: estimated from photos and the sketch (19 Nov): back wall about 37 m from the stage front (range 34-40 m), plus the 6.0 m stage-depth placeholder. The old cable plan's 54.7 m (kept in the v1 file) disagrees with both the sketch, which is drawn close to scale and puts the back wall about 9.7 m past the golf limit, and the stage-view photos. Not measured: tape the golf limit to the back wall to settle it.
auditorium.ceiling_confidence: estimated from photos (19 Nov): the side walls rise about 7.5-8 m to the black ceiling structure, using a 2.1 m door as the ruler; 8.5 m used for the ceiling deck, +-1 m

stage.front_x_confidence: not measured: the stage depth is unknown; 6.0 is the v1 estimate, used only to place the drawing. Every x below moves with it.

corner_curves.confidence: not measured: shape and size scaled off the sketch
corner_curves.note: Part of the stage (team 18 Nov): the stage front curves round to the side wall.

stage.height_confidence: estimated from photos (19 Nov): a person standing beside the runway in the empty-room photo, and four risers on the side stairs. About 0.9 m, range 0.8-1.0 m
stage.depth_note: The stage-view photos were taken from a camera roughly 9-13 m behind the stage front, so the stage may be deeper than the 6 m placeholder. Kept at 6 m; it doesn't change the golf zone.

runway.length_confidence: measured: stage front to runway tip (team 18 Nov)
runway.z_confidence: measured: 11.65 m from the top wall
runway.note: Raised, part of the stage; players can't cross it. The sketch also shows 22.1 m beside the runway; the team gave 22.54 m as the runway length. The v1 dotted extension (about 8.6 m) is not on the sketch; whether one will be built is still open.
runway.height_confidence: estimated from photos (19 Nov), same as the stage
runway.width_check: Photos (19 Nov) suggest the runway's white top is closer to 2.0 m wide: the performers on it only come out at a normal height (about 1.6-1.7 m) if it is. Kept at the measured 2.4 m. Check whether 2.4 m includes the black skirt or the stair units.

runway_side_items.note: The same on both sides (team 18 Nov): one set of stairs nearest the stage, then two speaker stands toward the tip. Speaker stands stick out 51.5 cm from the runway side (measured). Stair depth, the sizes of all six items and their positions along the runway are not measured: 'from_tip' is scaled off the sketch.

photo_estimates._about: From the team's photos of the auditorium in use (services, a 2020 event with house lights on), 19 Nov 2026. The photos aren't stored in the repo because they show identifiable people. Method and working: docs/13-auditorium-from-photos.md. Estimates, not measurements: build to none of them.
photo_estimates.floor: Light grey, smooth and slightly glossy (polished concrete or sheet vinyl look)

walls.top: Dark navy-black acoustic panels; a row of round surround speakers about 3.7 m up; two doors with exit signs; blue wall-wash lights near the top
walls.bottom: Dark wall with a long glazed band at floor level looking into a lit room (foyer?), roughly from x 9 to 31; beige diamond-quilted acoustic panels from about x 31 to the back wall; surround speakers; an exit door near the back corner
walls.back: Black drapes; the sound console in front; exit doors either side; a confidence monitor with a red clock hung over the console, facing the stage. The stage-view photos show four exit signs across the back, so there may be more doors than the sketch shows

ceiling.note: Black, exposed ducts and beams, a grid of black cylinder downlights hanging below it

side_trusses.note: Along both side walls, with white LED batons and moving heads; the LED batons are the white dashes in the stage-view photos

delay_screen.note: A long LED screen hung along the room over the runway, lit face toward the audience, with an unlit lattice section at the back end. Underside about 3.5 m (it lines up with the 3.5 m-high camera's horizon in the 2020 photo)

stage_set.led_wall: About 15 x 2.5 m, upstage, bottom about 1.8 m above the deck
stage_set.portrait_screens: Two each side: inner about 1.6 x 2.6 m hung, outer about 1.8 x 4.4 m standing near the curved corners
stage_set.line_arrays: Hung at the ends of the LED wall
stage_set.deck: Glossy pale grey, black fascia, light-blue LED strip along the front edge
stage_set.runway: Glossy white top, black skirt; black side stairs with four risers

photo_estimates.confidence_monitors: One over the console and one hung mid-room on the 11.65 m side, both facing the stage, each with a red LED clock

camera_heights.stage_view_photos: about 2.45 m above the stage deck
